hero.undertitel: Bible teaching and podcast – for you who want to go deeper

body:
📖

Hi, I'm Becca!

Welcome! I'm passionate about the Bible and about helping more people discover how alive, relevant and deep it is. On my YouTube channel BibelBecca I share Bible teaching, answer Bible questions and clear up common misconceptions about what the Bible actually says.

It started with a simple thought: what if more people could discover the joy of truly studying the Bible – not just reading isolated verses, but understanding the context.

🎙️

The BibelBecca podcast

In the BibelBecca podcast I take time to go deeper. Here you'll find longer conversations and teaching about everything from grace and works to how we read the Bible in everyday life. The podcast is available on YouTube and Spotify – new episodes are released regularly.

Besides the podcast I make shorter videos with Bible questions and answers, and sometimes live streams where you can ask questions directly.

✝️

What I believe

I stand on classic Christian faith: the Bible is God's word and Jesus Christ is the saviour of the world. My desire is for the content to be biblically grounded, honest and accessible – whether you're new to faith, have been a Christian for a long time or are simply curious.

💛

Join the journey

BibelBecca is run on a non-profit basis. The best way to support is to subscribe, share the videos with others and pray for the work. Would you also like to help sponsor equipment for the podcast? Check out the sponsor page!
